messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected for runtime pool 'prod-llm' in us-west-2. CrashLoopBackOff on multiple runtime pods. Pager duty triggered. thread_ts=1749998888

jorge (sre-oncall): got the page, looking now. can someone drop pod logs? :eyes:

maya (engine-lead): i'm on call for engine side. any core dumps? which image tag?

alex (infra): seeing repeated segfaults in kube logs: `SIGSEGV` from process `redwood-runtime` (v2.4.1). nodes: gke-prod-7, gke-prod-9. quick `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep runtime`:
```
runtime-5b7d4    0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  3   4m
runtime-6c3f1    0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  4   3m
runtime-8f0aa    1/1 Running         0   20m
```

jorge (sre-oncall): tail of container log from runtime-5b7d4:
```
[2026-03-15T10:02:14Z] ERROR runtime: unhandled signal SIGSEGV (code=0x1, fault addr=0x7ffd6c1f)
Backtrace: 0x7f2a1b.. 0x7f2a1e..
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
Aborted (core dumped)
```

maya (engine-lead): cuda illegal address + segfault in v2.4.1 fused-kernel path. Likely a regression from the custom kernel changes in the last release. assigning: i'll dig into repro and patch.

alex (infra): immediate mitigation options: 1) scale down runtime deployment to 0 to stop crashloop noise and let autoscaler restabilize 2) cordon/drain affected nodes 3) rollback deployment to v2.4.0 image. Which do we want first?

jorge (sre-oncall): do rollback to v2.4.0 now. we need to reduce customer impact. running:
```
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.4.0 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime -n prod
```

alex (infra): rollback initiated. rollout shows 2/3 updated so far. also cordoning gke-prod-7 as it's repeatedly crashing:
```
kubectl cordon gke-prod-7
kubectl drain gke-prod-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

tina (support): is there a customer impact assessment? support sees a jump in 500s for some customers on dedicated clusters. how many calls/alerts should we flag?

priya (customer-success): just got pinged by ACME corp — their flows hit errors ~10:02-10:06 UTC. marking as P1 for ACME, notifying slack and sending customer note. we'll keep them updated.

maya (engine-lead): rollback completed on control plane, pods are coming up on v2.4.0. initial health checks passing for the canary pod. monitor CPU/GPU mem and errors.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3239, severity=SEV2, created_by=incident-bot. PagerDuty incident link: https://pd.example/INC-2026-3239

jorge (sre-oncall): still see one pod restarting on gke-prod-9, logs show same SIGSEGV but that node has older GPU drivers. running `kubectl describe node gke-prod-9` now.

alex (infra): gke-prod-9 shows NVIDIA driver 525.60, kernel 5.15. we've got a mix of drivers across pool — risk for weird cuda behavior. i'm scheduling a node drain to reprovision drivers if rollback doesn't fully resolve.

maya (engine-lead): note: stack trace implicates fused_attention_kernel::compute when sequence_len>2048 (rare in prod but some customers hit it). adding a quick guard patch to disable fused path for now. patch will be cherry-picked to v2.4.1-hotfix if needed.

jorge (sre-oncall): handoff time — i've stabilized immediate customer impact via rollback and cordon. handing to @maya for engine-root cause + hotfix. @maya you're the active investigator. handing at 1749999050. :white_check_mark:

maya (engine-lead): taking over. will attempt hotfix patch and run canary build on a staging node with same driver matrix. ETA 30–45m. creating bug ticket ENG-4821.

tina (support): sent initial status update to ACME and 3 other affected customers. included workaround (retry/backoff) and ETA for fix ~45m.

incident-bot: NOTE: automated metrics alert suppressed for crashloops after rollback; keep monitoring.

alex (infra): for follow-up: full node inventory + driver matrix, and add driver validation to node bootstrap. filing infra ticket INF-251.

maya (engine-lead): quick repro notes for the team: docker run locally with model-config sequence_len=4096 + small batch on GPU with driver 525 triggers illegal address in fused kernel. workaround: set env var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` or use v2.4.0.

```
export REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1
./run_inference --model t5-large --seq-len 4096
```

jorge (sre-oncall): closing immediate page. leave incident open for RCA and follow-ups. next steps: postmortem, hotfix release v2.4.1-hotfix, infra driver rollout. I'll update the incident ticket with timeline. :memo:

priya (customer-success): will coordinate customer follow-ups and share postmortem with ACME once ready. thanks everyone. :heart:

maya (engine-lead): will post an interim report in ~1h with reproduction steps and patch PR link.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (rollback applied). Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 pending RCA.
